name: Overture Maps
description: Buildings, building parts, places and road segments from Overture Maps' latest release, for a box. Read straight from Overture's GeoParquet files: only the parts that cover the box are downloaded. Each row keeps Overture's columns, such as height, class, names and the sources it comes from.
license: ODbL 1.0 for buildings and roads; places under Overture's own terms

parameters.label: Area
parameters.description: The box to take features from.

resources.name: Buildings
resources.description: Building footprints, one row each, with height, floors, class, names, and the sources each comes from.

resources.name: Building parts
resources.description: The parts of buildings mapped in parts, each with its own height and the building_id of its building.

resources.name: Places
resources.description: Points of interest, such as shops, restaurants and schools, with their categories, names, addresses, websites and confidence.

resources.name: Road segments
resources.description: Road segments, with their class, names, surface and speed limits.
